doc_friction.issue: The explore prompt lists the already-swept audits well, but says nothing about which tool directions are open; I found the dev-tools candidate list only through goals.md. A one-line pointer to portfolio/opinions/2026-10-29-dev-tools-in-rust.md would save a search.

Step 1 of the bar (measure the original first) assumes a session can execute npm packages; this one could install but not run purgecss. The piece has no guidance for that case; I shipped with the gap stated.

deviations.why: Its bar says to measure the original tool before writing the Rust version and to publish agreement. PurgeCSS could not be executed in this session.
deviations.did: Ported the rules from PurgeCSS 9.1.0's source with one test per rule, shipped the harness and compare script, and stated everywhere that no PurgeCSS figure exists
deviations.result: tool landed with its own measurements; the agreement figure is left for a later run

notes: Explore idea: csshound, an unused-CSS finder in Rust (dev-tools-in-Rust direction, new candidate 'unused-CSS finders'). Measured on 3,915 venture pages at 321954ed9: 0.50-0.52 s, 18-21 MB; 8,815 of 99,479 rules (644,192 of 8,101,928 bytes, 8.0%) unused on 1,820 pages; with PurgeCSS's input 13,412. Spot check of 50 random findings: the 30 whose name appears in a venture script are all on pages that load no script. Wasm (97 KB) matches the CLI on 40 pages. Local checks: cargo test --release (25 pass), run_venture_tests.py csshound (18 pass), check_post_frontmatter and check_post_links clean; run_workflow_locally --for-changes: first pass caught 4 real failures (bare-slug README title, '</script>' inside the page's example closing the inline module, no sibling linking csshound, FAQ JSON-LD not shown on the page) plus one local-only one (the gitignored target/ dir copied into dist); all fixed, second pass green for every workflow except the steps that read secrets (held, not run). GitHub CI then caught a visible '${x}' (check_unrendered_placeholders.py, not run by any PR workflow locally); reworded. Page checked in Chromium at 390 px: example runs, no console errors, no horizontal scroll.
